paragraphs: Advent has sold online solutions that assist government offices to better do their jobs since 2005. The stated audience is prosecutors, probation, judges, sheriffs and other agencies.

Advent Diversion Manager is a web-based platform that automates and manages diversion programs. Advent eLearning supplies prosecutors, probation, police and other agencies with over 40 evidence-based, behavior-changing courses. A citation processing product handles high volumes end to end, covering document management, eligibility review, online education, fee disbursement, case filing, and adjudication. Advent eDocs pulls paper and electronic documents into a centralized, web-based document management system. A billing service called Payafee covers fees such as booking, boarding, false alarm and other ordinance violations.
The about page says the product range assists over 300 local government agencies. Staff are described as financial and information technology experts.

quote.text: Advent has become “the go-to resource” for prosecutors, probation, judges, sheriffs and other agencies.
